I have wanted to make a stuffed crochet quilt for SO LONG! You know those soft, furry kinda rippled blankets? that was the inspo for this! And I have been trying to figure out a way to replicate one in crochet for a million years. I wanted to make it as soft as humanly possible and the combination of the chenille yarn (incredible @CygnetYarns  jellybaby yarn btw!) and the stitch have made it a sensory dream 😍

This stitch looks very advanced and complicated, but I hope this tutorial will help you understand it! It’s absolutely gorgeous and I’m sure a blanket made out of this would be incredible! 🥰❤️ The yarn I’m using is in my link in bio ❤️ #crochettiktok #crochetersoftiktok #crochet #diy #crochettutorial

Learn the Even Moss Stitch An easy crochet stitch with a simple 2-row repeat that works up quickly and creates a beautiful textured fabric. This beginner friendly crochet stitch uses just slip stitches and half double crochet (US) / half treble crochet (UK), making it easy to learn and remember. Perfect for blankets, scarves, dishcloths and lots of other crochet projects. Follow along with my step-by-step Even Moss Stitch crochet tutorial, with both US and UK crochet terms included. #crochettutorial #crochetstitch #evenmossstitch #crochetforbeginners #purlnhook
